description: Run a DNS check of a custom domain now and return its status, `problem` and DNS records. One check after the DNS records exist is enough: BrewPage keeps checking on its own (`nextCheckAt`) and reading the status needs no check; another check fits only after a DNS change. Status: pending_dns (DNS records not seen yet), verifying (DNS records found, HTTPS being issued), active (live), lost (DNS records broke after going live; still served until `graceEndsAt`; restored records and one more check bring it back). `problem` names the fix. Addressed by publication (type, namespace, id; a profile token or an owner token added to the profile) or by hostname (an admin profile token). A repeat within seconds answers 429 with Retry-After.

hostname.description: Custom domain as a bare hostname, e.g. www.example.com; instead of type, namespace and id

ownerToken.description: By publication: a profile token or an owner token added to the profile. By hostname: an admin profile token. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Publication type; with namespace and id, instead of hostname

name: check_domain
title: Check custom domain DNS
